name: print-social-purple-lime-business-quote-post-grid
title: Deep purple and lime business posts with bold quote cards
whatItIs: A 3x3 grid of square post templates in dark purple, lime and lavender with bold sans headlines, big star and arrow glyphs, a large '85%' stat and some duotone photo tiles.
whatItMeans: Modern, confident consulting energy; lime is the highlight in an otherwise dark set.
techniques: Alternate solid colour cards with photo tiles in a single palette.
Use huge simple glyphs (arrows, star) as graphic anchors.
Set headlines in heavy grotesque with one line highlighted.
Include a large stat card to vary the rhythm.
bestFor: Business, coaching and consulting social accounts

vocabulary.definition: A set of reusable post layouts.
A photo tinted with two colours.
A large symbol used as the main graphic.
A post built around one large number.
